cells.gaps: No fact gives the policy a stated period, a delivery plan or a report against its targets. Governance is held only from the 2007 contents headings, outside the 36-month window, and no finance fact has been found; no dated event falls in the last twelve months.
cells.note: National ICT Policy (Maitlamo): approved by the National Assembly in August 2007, text public, no end year and no successor on record, so it stands as an open policy in force. An open policy stops at stage 3, and no delivery plan or results report has been found for stage 4.
